{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, ensure it's string type
if data['revenue'].dtype != 'object':
    data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].astype(str)

data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_mask = data['customer_age'] == -1
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_neg1_mask.sum()}')"}
